# tfutils_kubernetes_auth_wait (Resource)

On create, sends a `SelfSubjectReview` with the token of the provider `kubernetes` block until the API server authenticates it as `username` `consecutive_successes` times in a row, for example until an OIDC identity provider newly associated with an EKS cluster reaches every API server. A 401 response means not yet; another username, a 403, or an expired JWT fails at once. Apply fails with the last response when the create timeout passes. Read makes no request; the wait runs again only when `username`, `consecutive_successes` or `triggers` change. Destroy does nothing.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "tfutils_kubernetes_auth_wait" "oidc" {
  username              = "oidc:ci-runner"
  consecutive_successes = 3

  provider = tfutils.cluster

  depends_on = [kubernetes_cluster_role_binding_v1.ci_runner]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `username` (String) Username that the API server must return, including the identity provider prefix.

### Optional

- `consecutive_successes` (Number) Number of successful reviews in a row needed to finish, so that a request routed to an API server that has not loaded the identity provider yet restarts the count.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))
- `triggers` (Map of String) Values whose change replaces the resource and runs the wait again.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as `username`.

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
